name: TechSF
description: Free technology job training and tech industry career placement
fullDescription: TechSF, run by San Francisco's Office of Economic and Workforce Development (OEWD), offers no-cost technology training, certifications, and job placement services through a network of local training providers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free tech training (for example: software engineering, cybersecurity, IT support, data analysis, digital marketing, Salesforce, tech sales, and video editing)
- Industry certifications
- Workshops
- Job placement services
- Career support services
- Training through partners such as BAVC, BAYCAT, Code Tenderloin, Dev/Mission, Goodwill, JVS, MEDA, and Upwardly Global
howToGetIt:
1. Submit a TechSF interest form on SF.gov
2. A TechSF coordinator will advise you on what you may qualify for and schedule an orientation
3. Attend the orientation
4. Enroll in a training program with your coordinator's help
5. Receive job placement support (questions: techsf@sfgov.org)
keywords: TechSF, San Francisco, free tech training, coding bootcamp, IT certifications, tech career, job placement, internship, career mentorship
